name: Set Timer by Function Name
description: Schedules a function (selected by name) to run after a set delay, optionally looping on an interval. Returns a Timer Handle that can be used to pause, clear, or query the timer.

inputs.name: Object
inputs.description: The object that owns the function to invoke. Usually self, but can be any object exposing the named UFUNCTION.

inputs.name: Function Name
inputs.description: Name of the function to call. Must match a UFUNCTION on the target object exactly (case sensitive).

inputs.name: Time
inputs.description: Delay in seconds before the first invocation. Connect a float variable or a literal number.

inputs.name: Looping
inputs.description: Whether the timer should repeat every Time seconds after the first call. True for periodic, false for one-shot.

outputs.name: Out
outputs.description: Execution pin that fires immediately after the timer is registered. Continue the graph from here.

outputs.name: Return Value
outputs.description: Handle that identifies the scheduled timer. Save it in a variable and pass it to Clear Timer / Is Timer Active later.
